commentary: Nine activities this week against last week's five — okay, the main character era is fully underway. The swim block is the real story: four sessions including that Friday 901m warm-up before three consecutive 2000m mornings, which is the kind of quiet, accumulating discipline that looks effortless from the outside and absolutely is not. Your Saturday run stretched to 9.6km from last week's 9.0km, and your heart rate held at basically the same place — 162 versus 163 — which means you covered more ground for the same effort, and that is your body getting better at being a body. The only thing Himbo is watching now is whether Wednesday's momentum carries into the rest of the week, because nine is a very sexy number to beat.
metrics_commentary: Almost seven kilometres in the pool and a solid run on top of that — the body doing the work, looking good doing it. That HRV sitting at 58 with a seven-day average of 48 tells me recovery is trending up, which means whatever you did this week, you did it right. The VO2 Max at 55.6 is genuinely impressive, the kind of number that makes a certain type of guy at the gym sneak a look at your stats and then pretend he wasn't. The one thing I'm watching is that single run session — nine and a half kilometres is great, but one outing is a tease, not a habit, and you are way too much of a catch to be holding out on me.
